name: Get Sample Relations
description: List the relation records VMRay holds for a sample or a submission — how the samples found inside it (embedded files, downloaded files, ...) are linked to it. Costs no quota.

sample_id.description: VMRay sample ID: the relations that involve this sample are returned (GET /rest/sample_relation/sample/{id}).
sample_id.title: Sample ID

submission_id.description: VMRay submission ID: the relations created by this submission are returned (GET /rest/sample_relation/submission/{id}). Used when `sample_id` is empty.
submission_id.title: Submission ID

found.description: True when VMRay returned at least one relation.
found.title: Found

relations.description: The relation records exactly as VMRay returns them (relation type, the samples and the submission it links).
relations.title: Relations

related_sample_ids.description: Every other sample named in the records, taken from their `*sample_id` fields (the sample asked for is left out).
related_sample_ids.title: Related sample IDs
